title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode18 A Show to Make You Smile

meta.Episode: Episode18 — A Show to Make You Smile

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Are you all right?
If you need someone to talk to, we're always here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think finding out Tsukasa didn't remember her may have come as a bit of a shock.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Poor thing... Is there anything we can do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The one thing that'll cheer her up is Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think the only way we can help is by getting Tsukasa to regain his memories as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I think this calls for a show!
That's sure to put a smile on her face☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
All right, everyone! Time for practice!
Let's begin with some vocal exercises.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sally sells seashells by the seashore♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Sally sells seashells by the seashore♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I scream, you scream, we all scream for ice cream♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: M-Miku! That tickles! What are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ No frowning! You need to smile♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Thanks for the reminder. Hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO! I think I just felt Tsukasa arrive!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's strange. I don't sense anyone else with him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I sense the same thing.
Miku, let's go find out what he's doing here alone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm... He should be around here somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like the little bunny from before.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I think you may be right. She's seemed a bit down lately.
Huh?
Hey, um, what's wrong? Why are you crying?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't cry, wipe those tears! Hmm...
Look! I'll do a snazzy dance for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That only made it cry even more?!
I guess there's nothing I can do...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, wait. Let's just watch for a moment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Close, but it's hoy, not boy!
Reach up and wave with both hands like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha! That's it! Now that you can do wonderhoy, you can consider yourself the prince's friend!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's stay here for a moment and watch.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What? We're not going to talk to him?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, he's doing his best to get our little friend to smile. We shouldn't interrupt his show.
